name: Littlestone Dimension of the Repetition-Free Teaching Separation Class
proof: The standard restriction recurrence $L(\mathcal H)=\max_x(1+\min\{L(\mathcal H_{x=0}),L(\mathcal H_{x=1})\})$ evaluates to three on the displayed finite class. The recursive computation is checked in $\texttt{sync/verify\_repetitionfree\_teaching.py}$.
